en: An old monochrome postcard view of a small European town street beside a narrow stream crossed by a stone arch bridge. On the right stands a large ornate civic building with classical detailing, likely the town hall and post office, and other multi‑storey houses line the street. Leafless trees, wooden railings along the road and canal, and a few figures give it a late‑autumn or winter feel. German text is printed at the top and along the right edge.
